name: Eigent
description: Runs a local multi-agent desktop workforce that splits tasks across specialized workers with browser, terminal, and file access on your own machine.

skills.name: Task Decomposition
skills.description: Splits a high-level request into parallel subtasks and assigns each to a specialized worker agent.

skills.name: Local Execution
skills.description: Grants workers browser, terminal, and filesystem access on the local machine so work happens without a cloud runtime.

skills.name: MCP Tooling
skills.description: Attaches MCP servers as shared tools so every worker in the workforce can reach the same external systems.
